With an interdisciplinary background in statistics, electronic engineering, and biology, I develop analytical and computational solutions for complex challenges in energy, science, and technology.

I hold an M.S. in Statistics from the University of California, Davis, and degrees in Electronic Engineering and Biology from the National University of Colombia.

## Areas of expertise

- Data science and statistical modeling
- Power systems and energy analytics
- Machine learning and optimization
- Scientific computing and software development
- Environmental analysis and sustainability.
